text:
A resident of the condo recommended this place, saying the doctor was skilled, meticulous, and provided good service and advice. So I decided to try it because it's very close to home.

You need to call to book an appointment beforehand. We were very disappointed with the time management by the counter staff and the doctor's service time. Our appointment was on March 2nd, 2024 at 6:00 PM. We arrived 10 minutes late, at 6:10 PM. We didn't receive a call at the scheduled time. That was fine, we waited. But what really upset us was the long wait. We didn't expect it to be this long. The first time, after 10 minutes, we asked how much longer, and the counter staff said another 10 minutes. The second time, another 10 minutes passed, and we still hadn't been called. We couldn't wait anymore and asked a third time, asking if they could ask the doctor how much longer it would be. In the end, we waited a total of about 35 minutes, from 6:10 PM to 6:45 PM. We would like them to manage things better. We can wait, it's not that we can't, but if a case is going to be slow, we would appreciate it if patients were informed in advance or at least given a heads-up.

And one more comment: It seemed like the doctor was rushing, but towards the end, they were very friendly and chatty. And they provided very good information about brushing teeth.

I'll have to decide again whether to continue using their services.
Overall, it's convenient because it's located in Central Ladprao and easily accessible by BTS.
